Tuesday, 5:40pm. Component review with three squads.

A dev from the Energy team tells me: "We rebuilt the date picker, yours didn't handle US formats."

That's the third one since March. Three date pickers, three different bugs in prod.

I didn't push back. I asked to see the ticket they'd opened with us. There wasn't one. They didn't know we took requests at all.

That one's on me.

So we changed something embarrassingly small: one Teams channel, an answer within 48 hours, and every rejected request explained in writing. In 6 weeks we went from 4 requests to 31, and nobody forked a component in that window.

The perfect docs were useless while nobody knew which door to knock on.

Does your design system have an official front door, or do teams find you by accident?
